guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以DTSS觀察集中污水系統，先分清幹管輸送與末端處理，再檢查尖峰、沉積、提升與備援的耦合。
guides.conceptEn: Use DTSS to examine centralized sewerage, distinguishing conveyance from treatment before checking peaks, sediment, lifting and redundancy.
procedure: 先點選「支線污染與流量入口」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「集中系統尖峰邊界」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把尖峰係數改成3，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2.4 m³/s。與基準 2 m³/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「深隧道有效斷面」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效面積減至0.45 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2 m/s。與基準 1.5 m/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「重力坡度與襯面」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把 n 改成0.020，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 5.450337 m³/s。與基準 7.267115 m³/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「暫態調蓄空間」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出流提高到0.8 m³/s，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4320 m³。與基準 5040 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「末端提升至處理廠」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把效率降成0.60，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 19.62 kW。與基準 16.35 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「長距離輸送時間」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效容積改成600 m³，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6 h。與基準 8 h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「沉積固體維護帳」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把固體分率提高到0.20，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 10000 kg/d。與基準 50000 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「水位與流量同步」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「共享提升與電源介面」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把各列A改成0.90，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.99 fraction。與基準 0.9975 fraction比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
procedureEn: Select the link-sewer load entry measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the centralized peak-flow boundary measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only the peak factor to3 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2.4 m³/s. Compare with baseline 2 m³/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the deep-tunnel clear section measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only clear area to0.45 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2 m/s. Compare with baseline 1.5 m/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the gravity slope and lining measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only n to0.020 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 5.450337 m³/s. Compare with baseline 7.267115 m³/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the transient storage space measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only outflow to0.8 m³/s with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4320 m³. Compare with baseline 5040 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the terminal lift to treatment measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only efficiency to0.60 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 19.62 kW. Compare with baseline 16.35 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the long-distance conveyance time measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only effective volume to600 m³ with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6 h. Compare with baseline 8 h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the deposited-solids maintenance ledger measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only solids fraction to0.20 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 10000 kg/d. Compare with baseline 50000 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the level/flow synchronization measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the shared lift and power interfaces measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only each train availability to0.90 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.99 fraction. Compare with baseline 0.9975 fraction and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
evidence: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「支線污染與流量入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
把尖峰歷線疊在各單元可用能力上，找出最早溢流點。在離線場景為「集中系統尖峰邊界」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
比較水位、流量與有效面積，再以斷面多點量測查偏流。在離線場景為「深隧道有效斷面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
量測縱坡與斷面，校準不同水位的流量曲線。在離線場景為「重力坡度與襯面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以五分鐘資料逐步積分，再與水位—容積曲線核對。在離線場景為「暫態調蓄空間」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同步量測流量、進出口壓差與真實功率，勿把視在功率當耗電。在離線場景為「末端提升至處理廠」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用示蹤突破曲線比較平均停留與最早突破，保留流量紀錄。在離線場景為「長距離輸送時間」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
秤重並烘乾配對樣品，分開報告乾量與濕量。在離線場景為「沉積固體維護帳」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「水位與流量同步」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
畫故障樹並標出共享設備，測試單列退出時的完整流程。在離線場景為「共享提升與電源介面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
evidenceEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for link-sewer load entry; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Overlay the peak hydrograph on available capacity for each unit and identify the first overflow point. Build an offline evidence table for centralized peak-flow boundary; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare level, flow and clear area, then inspect nonuniformity with multiple section measurements. Build an offline evidence table for deep-tunnel clear section; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Measure slope and section and calibrate the discharge curve at several depths. Build an offline evidence table for gravity slope and lining; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
Integrate five-minute data and compare with the stage-storage curve. Build an offline evidence table for transient storage space; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Synchronize flow, pressure difference and real-power measurements; do not confuse apparent and real power. Build an offline evidence table for terminal lift to treatment; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare tracer mean residence and early breakthrough while retaining flow records. Build an offline evidence table for long-distance conveyance time; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Weigh and dry paired samples, reporting wet and dry mass separately. Build an offline evidence table for deposited-solids maintenance ledger; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for level/flow synchronization; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Draw a fault tree marking shared assets and replay the process with one train unavailable. Build an offline evidence table for shared lift and power interfaces; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
pitfalls: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
把設計總能力當成檢修時可用能力，會漏算停機風險。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
只使用名目斷面會忽略攔污物或沉積造成的縮減。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
沉積與生物膜改變粗糙度，沿用初建值可能高估能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
水位計零點漂移會看似增加儲量，需獨立水尺確認。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
葉輪磨損或閥門節流會改變工作點，須查泵曲線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
隔板破損可能造成短流；擴大容積未必能消除捷徑。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
把4%寫成4會造成100倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
兩列共用一個關鍵閥門，該閥失效仍會同時停產。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
pitfallsEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Using installed capacity during maintenance overlooks unavailable equipment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Nominal area misses reductions caused by debris or sediment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Sediment and biofilm alter roughness; an as-built value may overestimate capacity. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Level-sensor zero drift can mimic storage gain; confirm with an independent staff gauge. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Impeller wear or throttling changes the operating point; inspect the pump curve. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A broken baffle may create short-circuiting; a larger volume need not remove the shortcut. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Using4 rather than0.04 produces a hundredfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A shared critical valve can stop both trains together. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。

related.title: 新加坡新生水系統
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.
